verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent service lists its own address on public records, scans official documents and uploads them to the customer's secure cloud account, and sends an email alert (plus a postcard) when mail arrives. That covers the core receive-and-scan workflow for service of process. However, the docs never commit to same-day scanning or describe a physical staffed street office; the 'alert as soon as official mail arrives' line only implies promptness. Missing for 10: an explicit same-day scan/upload commitment, documentation that a physical street-address office accepts in-person service, and independent or hands-on corroboration of turnaround times.
